name: exchange
title: Exchange
summary: People trade perpetual futures on any priced asset the app lists: order books, market and limit orders, cross margin with leverage, funding, liquidations, live charts and a portfolio.

env.name: EXCHANGE_QUOTE_CURRENCY
env.doc: The currency collateral, prices and PnL are counted in, as clients show it (USD, USDC, points). Display only: the engine never converts.

env.name: EXCHANGE_QUOTE_DECIMALS
env.doc: Decimals shown for amounts in the quote currency (0–8).

env.name: EXCHANGE_TAKER_FEE
env.doc: Fee on taker fills as a fraction of notional (0.00045 = 4.5 bps), 0–0.05. Fees go to the fee account.

env.name: EXCHANGE_MAKER_FEE
env.doc: Fee on maker fills as a fraction of notional; negative is a rebate, paid by the fee account (never more than the taker fee).

env.name: EXCHANGE_DEFAULT_LEVERAGE
env.doc: Leverage for a market until the trader picks one (capped at the market's max).

env.name: EXCHANGE_FAUCET_AMOUNT
env.doc: Test funds: new accounts start with this balance and the faucet tops a balance back up to it once per cooldown. 0 = no faucet (collateral only through exchange.Deposit). Never turn on where collateral is real money.

env.name: EXCHANGE_FAUCET_COOLDOWN
env.doc: How often one account may use the faucet (1m–720h).

env.name: EXCHANGE_SIM_ENABLED
env.doc: Run a simulated market maker and 12 simulated traders for demos. Their trades are flagged sim and stats show the simulated share of volume and open interest.

env.name: EXCHANGE_CATALOG_FILE
env.doc: Path to a JSON array of markets (symbol, name, max_leverage, sz_decimals, tick_size, min_notional, oi_cap, …) upserted when the engine starts. Admin-owned status and manual prices are left alone. Unset: the catalog is managed in Admin → Exchange.

env.name: EXCHANGE_PRICE_POLL_INTERVAL
env.doc: How often the engine asks the installed price feed for every market's index price (250ms–1h).

env.name: EXCHANGE_PRICE_STALE_AFTER
env.doc: A live index price older than this is stale: only orders that reduce a position are accepted until it updates.

env.name: EXCHANGE_FUNDING_INTERVAL
env.doc: How often funding is paid (1m–8h). Rates are quoted per hour either way.

env.name: EXCHANGE_LIQ_PARTIAL_NOTIONAL
env.doc: Positions larger than this (quote currency) are liquidated 20% at a time; smaller ones in full.

env.name: EXCHANGE_TRADE_RETENTION
env.doc: How long the public trade tape is kept. Accounts' orders, fills and ledger, and candles, are kept for good.

stitch: Define the catalog: EXCHANGE_CATALOG_FILE, exchange.UpsertCatalog from app code, or Admin → Exchange; replace the development catalog in SeedDev (backend/internal/exchange/account.go).

Install a price feed: with the oracle feature, add backend/internal/api/stitch_exchange_oracle.go from FEATURE.md → Stitching (a market's price_feed is the oracle feed key); otherwise implement exchange.PriceFeed and call exchange.SetPriceFeed from an init(). Seed prices work only in development.

Decide where collateral comes from: test funds (EXCHANGE_FAUCET_AMOUNT) or real money through exchange.Deposit / exchange.Withdraw in the payment's transaction (check exchange.TransferStatus before paying out). Real money means leveraged derivatives: get the licences first (FEATURE.md → Compliance).
Run one API instance, or accept that only the engine's leader serves trading (others answer 503 exchange_standby); set REDIS_URL with more than one instance.
Decide whether demos run the simulation outside development (EXCHANGE_SIM_ENABLED) and say on screen that sim trades are simulated.
Rename Markets / Portfolio in web/src/features/exchange/registry.ts and mobile/src/features/exchange/registry.tsx if the product calls them something else.
